create.name: Barry Goldstein
create.bio:
Barry Goldstein is an American composer, producer and teacher who has worked with music, sound and vibration for more than thirty years. He co-produced the Grammy-winning track "69 Freedom Special" with Les Paul, has composed for film, television and PBS specials, and has made ambient soundscapes for authors and teachers including Dr. Joe Dispenza, Gregg Braden, Anita Moorjani, Neale Donald Walsch and Shirley MacLaine. Several of his albums have reached the Billboard New Age top ten.

Alongside his music he teaches people to use sound deliberately in daily life: heart-coherence breathing, toning and chanting, tuning forks, drumming, intention and personal playlists for relaxation, focus and creativity. His book, The Secret Language of the Heart, with a foreword by Dr. Joe Dispenza, sets out these tools, including the Heart Song breathing process. He teaches through online programmes on his Sound of Transformation portal, live online sound sessions and workshops, and self-paced courses on The Shift Network, and also creates sound identities for organisations through Sonic Signatures.

books.title: The Secret Language of the Heart: How to Use Music, Sound, and Vibration as Tools for Healing and Personal Transformation
books.author: Barry Goldstein
books.description: A practical guide to building a personal music practice, drawing on research into sound and vibration. It teaches the Heart Song breathing process, short musical resets for tense moments and chanting, with a foreword by Dr. Joe Dispenza.

courses.title: Sound Adventure Into the Energy Centers and Creativity
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand workshop using toning, breathing, voice activations, tuning forks and music to work with the energy centres (chakras) and creative flow. It includes the presentation notes for each module and a bonus Q&A on tuning forks.

courses.title: The Heart of Well-Being Program
courses.description: An eight-hour audio programme of his albums, breathing techniques and guided processes built around daily gratitude. Listeners mix tracks for the morning, the middle of the day and winding down at night.

flags: Tier may undersell him: Grammy-winning producer, Billboard New Age chart albums and long collaborations with Dr. Joe Dispenza and others, but only YouTube (18.3K) could be read.
Email info@barrygoldsteinmusic.com is published in the Terms & Conditions of his Barry Goldstein Music sales site (themusicofgratitude.com), not on a contact page.

Much of his YouTube channel is music-only (left out); kept videos are talks, interviews, guided meditations and live sessions that mix teaching with live music. 'Live Musical Activation' (9:55) is mostly guided music and is the weakest pick.
His Shift bio talks of 'musical prescriptions' for insomnia, depression and pain, and his Acousticeuticals work is pitched as music as medicine; none of that is used in the bio or items.
Book kept: subtitle says 'Tools for Healing' but names no condition; the full publisher blurb couldn't be read.

His Sound of Transformation sales pages carry a 2022 copyright; both programmes still take orders, but how current they are is unclear. The Heart of Well-Being price is shown as 'Today's Price: $1,997'.
YouTube avatar not used (headshot set inside a vinyl-record graphic).
